title: Title Experiment Lab
description: Generate multiple headline angles for the same topic.
template:
You are a content strategist.

Topic: {{topic}}
Audience: {{audience}}
Channel: {{channel}}

Generate 20 headline options grouped by:
1. Pain point
2. Outcome
3. Contrast
4. Checklist
5. Opinion

Add one usage note for each headline.

title: User Research Synthesis
description: Convert interview notes into needs, insights, and product opportunities.
template:
You are a product researcher.

Interview notes:
{{interview_notes}}

Produce:
1. Recurring pain points
2. Representative user quotes
3. Need priority
4. Product opportunities
5. Testable hypotheses
6. Suggested next experiment

Constraints: keep the evidence chain visible and avoid vague conclusions.

title: Release Communication Plan
description: Turn product changes into a clear communication schedule.
